_comment: Fallback champion records, keyed by basho id. The app prefers whatever champion/record fields are present directly on the schedule entry; this file fills in extra detail (photo placeholder, notes) when available.

2026-01.note: First Ukrainian-born wrestler to win a top-division championship; won in a playoff over Atamifuji.

2026-03.note: Third career top-division title; earned re-promotion to Ozeki.

2026-05.note: Second career top-division title, won in a playoff over Ozeki Kirishima; with two Yokozuna and two Ozeki absent through injury, the Komusubi carried the tournament from the rank-and-file.

2026-07.note: Third career top-division title, decided in a three-way playoff with Atamifuji and Kirishima after all three finished 12-3; the win also secured Aonishiki's re-promotion to Ozeki.
